I can help you set up persistent API credentials. A few options depending on scope:

**For Claude Code only** (recommended for security—keeps credentials isolated):
Use the `/update-config` skill to set environment variables in `settings.json`. They'll load automatically when Claude Code starts.

**For all PowerShell shells** (system-wide on Windows):
Add them to your PowerShell profile (`$PROFILE`), or set them as Windows environment variables via System Properties.

**For Bash shells**:
Add to `~/.bashrc` or `~/.bash_profile`.

Which scope do you want, and what are the credential names (e.g., `API_KEY`, `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID`)? I can set them up for you.
